author: reek
body: Time-domain transient analysis. Simulates circuit behaviour over time using numerical integration and provides measurement functions for rise time, period, frequency, and RMS.

author: reek
body: Rise time from 10% to 90% of the signal swing. Computes the low and high thresholds from peak and valley, then finds the first crossing times for each threshold.

author: reek
body: Auto-detects the signal period from zero crossings. Finds the first two positive-going zero crossings and returns their time difference.
